Priya (release-manager): @here Quick preflight snapshot for this week's release train. Quiet window Thu 2026-03-26 10:00 UTC -> Mon 2026-03-30 06:00 UTC. Please run the new backcompat check and flag any schema migrations without compatibility flags. Link: https://redwood.internal/preflight/s-2026-03-23-1723
Deploy-Bot: Quiet-window created: 2026-03-26T10:00Z -> 2026-03-30T06:00Z (id: q-24200033)
Priya (release-manager): Canary plan: canary -> 5% (30m) -> 25% (30m) -> 100%. Rollout thermostat: pause if latency +25% vs baseline or error-rate >0.8%.
Priya (release-manager): Backcompat script: `./tools/run_backcompat.sh <artifact>`; output goes to /artifacts/backcompat/<run-id>. If it fails, tag @eng-sre and paste the log.
Matt: ACK. I'll validate the service mesh config before canary.
Hao: quick Q — what exactly counts as "non-critical" change for the quiet window?
Priya (release-manager): non-critical = any change that can be rolled without DB migration or requires coordinated client updates. Critical examples: breaking schema migrations, network infra changes, major quant changes to runtime.
Sam: Will the embeddings model bump be included in this train?
Priya (release-manager): Not this week — embeddings model update is deferred. We keep generation models on the canary list.
Lia: I'll own rollback runbook and confirm runbook links in the release docs.
Matt: Adding rollback playbook to the release checklist now. :thumbsup:
Hao: Running backcompat against canary image now. Will post results in thread.
Deploy-Bot: Canary rollout scheduled: 2026-03-26T10:05Z -> canary-id c-24200033
Hao: backcompat pass ✅ (run id bc-778). No incompatibilities found for the canary artifacts I tested.
Priya (release-manager): Awesome — thanks. If anyone hits an unexpected schema change, do not escalate the deployment; pause and call @oncall (eng-sre).
Matt: Noted. Syncing with SRE on slack-call in 15.
Priya (release-manager): Thanks team — we'll post a short readout after the 25% window. Ping me in DM if you need help.
